name: A/P Aging Detail
description: Provides a reference on how to access the AP Aging Detail report from the QuickBooks Online Report Service.

parameters.name: shipvia
parameters.description: Filter by the shipping method as stored in Invoice.ShipMethodRef.Name. Supported Values: Any shipping method as sent in the Invoice.ShipMethodRef.Name attribute at Invoice create- or update-time.

parameters.name: term
parameters.description: Filters report contents based on term or terms supplied. Supported Values: One or more comma separated term IDs as returned in the attribute, Term.Id of the Term object response code.

parameters.name: end_duedate
parameters.description: The range of dates over which receivables are due, in the format YYYY-MM-DD. start_duedate must be less than end_duedate. If not specified, all data is returned.

parameters.name: accounting_method
parameters.description: The accounting method used in the report. Supported Values: Cash, Accrual

parameters.name: start_duedate
parameters.description: The range of dates over which receivables are due, in the format YYYY-MM-DD. start_duedate must be less than end_duedate. If not specified, all data is returned.

parameters.name: custom1
parameters.description: Filter by the specified custom field as defined by the CustomField attribute in transaction entities where supported. Supported Values: Name of custom field.

parameters.name: custom2
parameters.description: Filter by the specified custom field as defined by the CustomField attribute in transaction entities where supported. Supported Values: Name of custom field.

parameters.name: custom3
parameters.description: Filter by the specified custom field as defined by the CustomField attribute in transaction entities where supported. Supported Values: Name of custom field.

parameters.name: report_date
parameters.description: Start date to use for the report, in the format YYYY-MM-DD.

parameters.name: num_periods
parameters.description: The number of periods to be shown in the report. Supported Values: A numeric value.

parameters.name: vendor
parameters.description: Filters report contents to include information for specified vendors. Supported Values: One or more comma separated vendor IDs as returned in the attribute, Vendor.Id, of the Vendor object response code.

parameters.name: past_due
parameters.description: Filters report contents based on minimum days past due. Supported Values: Integer number of days. no filtering

parameters.name: aging_period
parameters.description: The number of days in the aging period. Supported Values: A numeric value.

parameters.name: columns
parameters.description: Column types to be shown in the report. Supported Values: create_by, create_date, doc_num*, due_date*, last_mod_by, last_mod_date, memo*, past_due*, term_name, tx_date*, txn_type*, vend_bill_addr, vend_comp_name, vend_name*, vend_pri_cont, vend_pri_email, vend_pri_tel. Additional columns with location tracking enabled: dept_name*
